**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/25 (Thu) 03:44
- [EVENT] The first assembly of the people, or "ecclesia," took place on Narukami Island.
- [EVENT] Filon took control of Narukami Island 1.5 months prior to the first ecclesia.
- [ASSISTANT_CREATED] A narrative describing the first ecclesia, including Filon's speech, citizen debates, and voting processes.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Filon addressed the citizens in Portuguese, stating, "Today, we gather to exercise our right to participate in the governance of our island."
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The first item on the agenda was a proposal to construct a new road connecting Narukami to the Inazuma archipelago.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Citizens voted by shouting "Sim" or "Não" to express their opinions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The second item on the agenda was a proposal to establish a system of schools for education.
- [EVENT] Filon called for a week's recess after the first ecclesia to draft packages of laws with his legal advisors.
- [EVENT] The citizens reconvened for another ecclesia three months later.
- [CHANGE] Filon announced his resignation as statesman to return to Mondstadt.
- [EVENT] The citizens were to elect a new statesman during the ecclesia.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Filon asked the citizens if anyone among them was suspected of wanting to appropriate power before the vote.
- [EVENT] A vote took place without discussion regarding any suspected individuals.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The new statesman elected was Ei, a known character from Genshin Impact and the former ruler of Inazuma.
- [EVENT] Filon expressed concern about the future of Narukami Island and the upcoming ostracism in six months.
- [EVENT] An ostracism was planned to take place six months after the election of the new statesman.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The majority of ostracons pointed to Ei during the ostracism, indicating she was thrown off the throne by Filon.
